producer.name: Suntory
producer.about: Suntory began in 1899, when Shinjiro Torii opened Torii Shoten in Osaka and started making and selling wine. In 1907 the shop launched Akadama Port Wine, a sweet wine whose profits later paid for whisky. Work on the Yamazaki Distillery, which the company calls Japan's first malt whisky distillery, began in 1923, and its first whisky, Shirofuda, was launched in 1929.
